properties.name: platform.logging.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable the platform logging starter.

properties.name: platform.logging.level
properties.description: Root logging level used by the logging starter.

properties.name: platform.logging.request.include-query-string
properties.description: Include HTTP query parameters in request logs.

properties.name: platform.logging.request.include-client-ip
properties.description: Include client IP address in request logs.

properties.name: platform.logging.request.excluded-paths
properties.description: Ant-style URL patterns that should be excluded from request logging.

properties.name: platform.logging.rolling-file.directory
properties.description: Directory where log files are written.

properties.name: platform.logging.rolling-file.name
properties.description: Base name of the log file.

properties.name: platform.logging.rolling-file.max-size
properties.description: Maximum size of an individual log file before rolling occurs.

properties.name: platform.logging.rolling-file.max-history
properties.description: Maximum number of days to retain archived log files.

properties.name: platform.logging.rolling-file.total-size-cap
properties.description: Maximum total size allowed for all archived log files.
